lines.desc: Provide a direct CAD-to-station-alerting interface (e.g., Motorola) enabling immediate automated toning upon dispatch without a separate dispatcher action, compatible with automated voice dispatching
lines.uom: Provide a direct CAD-to-station-alerting interface (e.g., Motorola) enabling immediate automated toning upon dispatch without a separate dispatcher action, compatible with automated voice dispatching (e.g., Locution, Wavefile) generating the announcement from CAD incident data. Support zoned alerting, re-toning on demand and on dispatch of additional units, automatic redirection of alerts to the station where a relocated unit is presently housed, logging of all alerting transmissions, and graceful failover to manual voice dispatch with immediate supervisor notification. Vendor shall state the guaranteed maximum latency from dispatch commit to station alert.

lines.desc: Provide a fire/EMS mobile client (iOS, Windows, Android) delivering incident detail, unit status, AVL-based turn-by-turn routing, mapping, and pre-plans. Vendor shall state the guaranteed maximum late
lines.uom: Provide a fire/EMS mobile client (iOS, Windows, Android) delivering incident detail, unit status, AVL-based turn-by-turn routing, mapping, and pre-plans. Vendor shall state the guaranteed maximum latency from dispatch commit to display and audible alert on the apparatus device; delivery must be effectively immediate, such that responders are not required to rely on secondary alerting applications. The client must operate in a degraded/offline mode using cached maps, pre-plans, and hydrant data, resynchronizing automatically when connectivity is restored.
